purpose: Bind current expectations to Topology 006: eight admitted architectural peers, all eight currently execution-ready after canonical control records and initial owner execution contracts were established, terminal Prose retirement, owner isolation, Programming continuity and Knowledge Recovery priority.

completion_expectations.requirement: PROSE is historically complete and terminally retired; it has no active work or execution domain.

SYSTEM_MASTER, CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE remain incomplete regardless of completed packets, tests, phases, ownership registration or subsystem evidence.
A system becomes complete only through explicit product-level completion authority; no chat, branch, workflow, phase, admission decision or ownership registration may infer completion.
PROGRAMMING is an incomplete active work program and is not an admitted peer system until explicit future authority establishes that boundary.

Architectural peer admission and execution readiness are distinct. Every current peer now has a canonical control record and initial owner execution contract, so the repository execution-readiness set currently equals the eight-peer architectural set.

job_expectations.requirement: Integrate CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE without taking their product semantics; never resurrect a retired system.

Finish shared Foundation/Spine and integration primitives only; while Knowledge Recovery 001 is selected, prioritize Programming proving-corpus recovery then authorized catalog/archive recovery as highest discretionary work.
Finish Learning and integrate upward without crossing another peer or Programming product semantics or creating active Prose work.
Finish Book; own any genuinely unfinished integration of preserved completed Prose capability as ordinary Book work; retain canonical Book authority; then integrate upward.
Finish Documents and integrate upward for document/artifact mechanics; receive no Prose work.
Own spreadsheet, math, data-analysis, BI and ledger product semantics over CORE shared data/execution primitives; use only its admitted owner lane for unattended execution.
Own image, photo, video, voice, audiobook and media product semantics over CORE shared runtime primitives; use only its admitted owner lane for unattended execution.
Own browser, calendar, communications and plugin/action policy over CORE shared connector-action runtime; external side effects still require explicit user authority.

Own research, knowledge and geospatial retrieval/provenance semantics over CORE shared connector/data/evidence runtime; consume BROWSER from CONNECTED_ACTIONS rather than taking browser action authority.
Continue the existing Programming engineering work program from preserved evidence and prepare explicit System Master admission/integration without silent peer promotion or cross-lane ownership.

lane_expectations.requirement: The architectural peer systems are exactly CORE, LEARNING, BOOK, DOCUMENTS, SPREADSHEET_DATA, MEDIA, CONNECTED_ACTIONS and RESEARCH_KNOWLEDGE.
The currently execution-ready peer lanes are exactly the same eight systems. Second Shift owner_files and telemetry allowed_lanes must match this execution-ready set exactly.

Second Shift compares the topology execution-ready peer set with registry owner_files and auto-provisions missing coverage only for an already-declared execution-ready peer when machine-resolvable; it never creates a system or resurrects a retired one.
PROSE has no standalone, child, inherited, repair, qualification, research, telemetry, successor or auto-provisioned execution. Historical Prose routes are stale and non-dispatchable.
Every active peer preserves semantic ownership and uses explicit interfaces for cross-system integration; Documents never receives Prose work.

Second Shift, repair routing, obligations, startup and current-state reconciliation fail closed on job/lane violations, stale owner heads, overlapping mutation claims, false execution readiness or retired-system resurrection.
Programming remains a named non-peer work program until explicit topology admission. It has no peer Second Shift lane and no peer telemetry ledger before admission.

authority_expectations.requirement: Exact-SHA, source-custody, canonical-writer, A-01, human, author, private, native, external, publication and production boundaries are preserved across every reconciliation.
Changed topology, integration, control-record or execution-readiness bytes require fresh evidence; no historical PASS transfers across changed subject, topology, readiness or ownership boundaries.

Canonical control records and owner-valid execution contracts are prerequisites for unattended execution readiness; ownership registration alone grants no external, publication, production, private, native or user-action authority.

carried_forward_expectations: All non-conflicting expectations from EXPECTATION-REGISTRY-005 remain historical guidance; this registry controls conflicts about Topology 006 peer admission, execution readiness, Prose lifecycle, priority, program job, work-program scope, lane ownership or auto-provisioning.
change_rule: Changing a system/work-program job, completion standing, retired standing, peer admission, execution readiness, ownership route or cross-lane exception requires explicit user direction and a current successor authority transaction.
